lines: aisha? aisha, can you hear me? move your mouse to do a little spin if you can hear me.
okay, you're in the reception of the veil sur. we have officially trespassed. very exciting. very legal.
quick systems check before you go anywhere. walk with WASD and interact with objects by pressing 'e'
you want to make sure you're sending me important intel so right click or press 'r' to use your camera, and left click to take a picture! pictures will automaticlaly be uploaded onto my cloud!
your pictures will load onto a notebook -- press tab to open it up. connect any key evidence with its corresponding picture to complete it
okay, now that you know the basics, let's get to work. we need to find out what veil sur is up to.
that elevator's might be your only way down, and of course it wants a passcode.
okay. think like an OYO employee. where would a tired person write down a password they're not allowed to write down?
employee files! i can't read a thing from this feed.
use your file viewer! we spent a pretty penny of our budget on your eyes, use them.
haha, they record everyone but they still can't seem to remember their own passwords!
go into camera mode and take a picture of it for safekeeping!
i think this is it. once you're in there's no coming back up.
remember, you're not equipped to fight. get close, get the shot and get out.
they're spying on everyone, now it's our turn to spy on them.
